title: Ketheric's Netherstone

sources.title: Confront the Elder Brain
markers: Only an illithid character holding the Netherstones

summary: One of the three quest stones needed to confront the Netherbrain.

fields.Acquisition: Take it from Reaper’s Embrace, Ketheric Thorm’s armour.
fields.Quest use: Bring it together with Orin’s and Gortash’s stones to the Morphic Pool. The combined Triune Netherstone lets a full illithid use Karsus’ Compulsion on the Crown of Karsus.
fields.Finale: Karsus’ Compulsion uses an Action at 20 ft and must channel until the next turn. Incapacitation, Stunned, Polymorphed or Knocked Out interrupts it.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
